message: Astra: Staying within Ya na’s investigation, what does “those marked points are key” imply about work completed before the opening, and what does it leave unknown? Which missing circumstance deserves attention first? Why would thinking longer clarify it better than an experimental opening, and what uncertainty could make drafting now premature? What evidence would justify either choice? Could you briefly distinguish your textual finding from your uncertainty in English, choose your next step, and carry it out?
